If you want a story about getting stoned, let me tell you about my Christmas break. I used to smoke a lot, about half an ounce a month, but then I got accepted into a doctorates level academic healthcare program and had to stop. After almost half a year of cold turkey soberness I decided to release some stress over the winter break. I called up my specialty florist and purchased an eight. This guy sells premium flowers and primarily deals in a single strain that has been lovingly cultivated by a local herb grower: a northern lights white widow cross...grinder stopping stickiness.

I should have blasted off from my couch with a single toke, but silly me decides to smoke an entire bowl.

Silly me.

I have no clue what happened. I remember feeling profound enlightenment followed by an understanding of the universe and the afterlife...I saw the essence of life moving through the time-space of cosmos, burning white hot with life and casting off dark used up energy. Ying and Yang suddenly became manifest and clearer than anything I had ever experienced before. Light cannot exist without the dark, dark cannot be appreciated without the light. Mortal enemies locked in an embrace of procreation. Suddenly I remember waking up...I do not know if the prior was all during a dream, or if I had fallen asleep after the fact. Nevertheless; I awoke, hours later, still high off my ass. Reality became an illusion, my existence seemed very matrix-y. I despised being alive because it felt like life was suddenly fake. Wake up. Go to school. Study. Come home. Study. Entertain myself. Sleep. Wash rinse repeat and hope my cycle eventually expands to include more pleasurable situations...such silly and quaint desires. Suddenly I heard a knock at my door...it struck fear into my very being. In my very core I knew that knock. It came from the beyond, from "those who come", the knock was an acknowledgment of my understanding and an invitation to experience more...to transcend these base mortal coils. You can answer the knock, but it will lead you to something so profoundly deep that it felt like I was standing on the rail of ship floating on an ocean so deep the water itself was black...and then hearing a whisper say "trust me, jump".

I did not answer the door. I could barely breathe. I willed the knock to go away and instantly it stopped. I kept telling myself, "just go to sleep, life will make sense again once you're sober...just go to sleep...sober MyDrunkAccount felt like life was real, didn't he? Just go to sleep, everything will be fine in the morning". But sleep, too, felt like death. Suddenly it struck me that we die every night and re-awake to try again, but try what? What are we supposed to figure out, to get right, to do, what must be done to move on? I don't want to die, but I'm so tired, I need to die, I need to sleep...I've slept many times before...it's not harmful...go to sleep...I don't want to die.

Eventually I went back to sleep. I woke up 12 hours later hung over.
